question: Can recorded pre-power changes explain AP preparation dynamics and fix the wrong idle heating forecast without future temperature or power?
family: One nonnegative global gain kappa into the existing preparation-memory H state; no new thermal state, beta, tau, workload coefficient or model search.
pre_equations: T'=-beta*(T-R)+H; H'=(kappa*(P_pre-P_reference)-H)/tau30. Per-session R/Hfirst nuisance estimated from pre AP only; first/last observed AP/time are preserved. R is not ambient.
power_input: Zero-order-hold recorded power events from first through last registered pre AP. Source event<=segment start, all<35; previous-value age/gap<=2.5s. P_reference is time-weighted held pre mean. Power is positive whole-device W; signed deviations are operational deviations, not negative consumption. Raw energy integration stays unchanged.
AP_input: Existing expanded registered-idle pre AP, >=15 samples/span>=55s, gap<=10s, query bracket hi<35. No window or sensor shift selected after outcomes.
future: After exact last pre AP anchor, external pre-power deviation is set to0 as a declared forecast assumption; inferred H decays with fixed tau30. Actual target lane schedule drives the already frozen LOAD_SLOW fast4/slow1 terms at unchanged beta/tau1920/original power proxy.
fit: Residualize each development session against its2 R/H nuisance columns, equal session weights, fit one nonnegative kappa. Opposite-gap block exclusion2 then final development6 =3 global fits. Projection diagnostics and local-state estimates reported separately.
identification: Numerical residual information and scaled3column condition, fold gain variation, deterministic sensitivity to assumed independent +/-0.05C pre AP perturbations (not confidence interval or certified sensor accuracy). No arbitrary accuracy PASS.
evaluation: All12; development uses opposite-gap gain, already seen confirmation6 final gain. Control is existing registered-idle initialization of fixed LOAD_SLOW, not original AP equation. SameAP35..120 and35..180/last covered sample, work and idle separately; MAE/max/peak/direction/worsening all shown.
energy_link_readout: At unchanged rejected pre-AP/power relation coefficients from previous study, replace ONLY AP initial R/H, report both original/zero4power heads. No energy refit, head selection or default adoption; static power relation failure remains a separate issue.
limits: Recorded actual-schedule conditional prediction, not arrival-to-response or online policy validation; pre exports offline, no live consumer. Previously viewed outcomes mean posthoc evidence even with session/block separation.
preservation: All original coefficients, raw/FAIL/closed plans, prior candidates, default simulator/RL/strict unchanged; separate ID/output and no automatic refit.
